DEATHKNIGHT_UNHOLY:
Use Power Infusion on the Unholy Deathknight when:

  • Their Summon Gargoyle is active with less than 22 seconds remaining.
  • They've summoned Army of the Dead and their primary undead pet (Abomination or Army Ghouls) has less than 18 seconds remaining.
  • They have Dark Transformation active and are not using Summon Gargoyle or Army of the Dead.
  • They have Dark Transformation active and do NOT have the Summon Gargoyle talent.
  • They can't summon Gargoyle again before the next Power Infusion comes off cooldown.
  • In encounters with 3+ enemies and they have Dark Transformation active or Death and Decay is ticking.
PRIEST_SHADOW:
Use Power Infusion on the Shadow Priest when:

  • They are in Voidform and don’t already have Power Infusion active.
  • They activate Dark Ascension and haven’t used Power Infusion recently.
  • They benefit from the Tier 31 (TWW) 2-piece set bonus to enhance cooldown synergy.
